methods.name: Reported observation
methods.examples: Source UPB, HMDA action code, ABS certificate balance
methods.required_evidence: Source/release, source field, unit/sign, observation date, publication/availability date, extraction receipt and missing/suppression state
methods.prohibited_shortcut: Do not change source sign, fill missing with zero, or equate publication date with observation date.

methods.name: Derived metric
methods.examples: Count share, DPD transition, exposure movement
methods.required_evidence: Input source IDs/hashes; row filters; grain; numerator and denominator; units; formula/version; reconciliation and null handling
methods.prohibited_shortcut: Do not average overlapping ratios, combine stock and flow, or hide an unresolved residual.

methods.name: Publisher-imputed / mixed provenance
methods.required_evidence: Publisher's documented imputation method and item-level flag when available; identify unknown item-level provenance explicitly
methods.prohibited_shortcut: Do not attribute every filled cell to a known method when item-level flags are absent.

methods.name: Model preprocessing imputation
methods.examples: UCI365 train-only median imputation with missing indicators
methods.required_evidence: Frozen split; training-only fit; original missing values/indicators; all-missing fallback; transform version; fit receipt
methods.prohibited_shortcut: Do not label an imputed value as an observed income, ratio or source value.

methods.name: Model prediction
methods.required_evidence: Population, target, time origin, horizon, feature availability, model/freeze ID, calibration, validation and uncertainty
methods.prohibited_shortcut: Do not relabel a next-month Taiwan behavioral target as Vietnam PD or a different default horizon.

methods.name: Declared scenario / assumption
methods.examples: P4 PD/LGD/EAD, 36-month bullet schedule, monthly EIR 0.004, base/adverse weights 0.7/0.3
methods.required_evidence: Owner/source or explicit uncalibrated label; parameter rationale; formula; base/alternative sensitivity; intended use; version
methods.prohibited_shortcut: Do not call declared values observed, empirically calibrated, accounting-compliant or production-ready.

methods.name: Forecast
methods.examples: No new forecast produced in this review
methods.required_evidence: Point-in-time available inputs; target/horizon; naive baseline; rolling/expanding time backtest; horizon error; interval coverage; release/version
methods.prohibited_shortcut: Do not fill censored/unmatured labels with zero or use future-revised data as if available at forecast time.

method_cards.name: D01 adjacent-month transition share
method_cards.target: Share of observed adjacent loan-month pairs that transition from an origin state to a destination state
method_cards.method: Count basis = destination pairs / admitted adjacent pairs from the origin state. Balance basis = destination opening UPB / known opening UPB from the origin state. Only consecutive calendar months link; gaps and terminal origins are excluded.
method_cards.validation: Independent reconstruction from the source panel reconciled 1,091 year/segment cells and 94 lifetime/segment cells; maximum floating discrepancy about 2.22e-16 within 1e-12 tolerance.
method_cards.limits: Repeated loan pairs are dependent observations. This is a descriptive pair share, not origination PD or fixed-horizon PD.

method_cards.name: UCI 350 next-month behavioral benchmark
method_cards.method: Train-only encoder statistics/vocabulary; client-disjoint stratified random split; constant/logistic/boosting candidates; separate calibration partition; freeze then score saved final test once. Selected boosting/raw.
method_cards.validation: Final test 3,001 clients / 664 positives; ROC AUC 0.777878, average precision 0.543521, Brier 0.136377, log loss 0.432887.
method_cards.limits: Random Taiwan cohort, not time split; not a 12-month, Basel or Vietnam PD. Final-test point estimates have no confidence interval in the saved card.

method_cards.name: UCI 365 one-year bankruptcy benchmark
method_cards.method: Train-only median imputation, signed asinh, train mean/population standardization and 64 missing indicators (128 encoded dimensions); 120-iteration histogram booster and calibration fitted on separate calibration split; selected boosting_platt by validation Brier/log loss rule.
method_cards.validation: Final 591 statements / 41 positives; AUC 0.962793792, AP 0.863689087, Brier 0.021610995, log loss 0.087159890. Exact feature groups kept together across partitions.
method_cards.limits: No released firm IDs or publication dates; exact groups are not entities. Not entity-independent OOT or deployed SME PD; one-year source target only.

method_cards.name: NMDB active-stock performance rates
method_cards.target: Quarterly delinquency, foreclosure and forbearance rates by publisher-defined market
method_cards.method: Use FHFA-reported quarter-end active-loan rates in native percentage-point units. Label P3089DL as 30–89 DPD: FHFA combines 30–59 and 60–89-day categories. Keep pre-series blanks, source suppression flags, and four mortgage markets separate.
method_cards.validation: National extract: 1,568 rows (4 markets × 4 series × 98 quarters). State extract: 79,968 rows (51 geographies × 4 markets × 4 series × 98 quarters), including 68 source-suppressed blanks (17 per series). Both receipts/hashes, coverage, duplicate keys, suppression semantics and value range verified.
method_cards.limits: Not cohort cumulative incidence or loan-level target. Route-specific geography packages are separate populations; latest two quarters are provisional; suppression and unavailable pre-series blanks remain null; All Mortgages must not be added to component markets.

method_cards.name: NMDB origination-flow and outstanding-stock market context
method_cards.target: Descriptive mortgage origination mix and quarter-end outstanding mortgage/UPB context
method_cards.method: Query source grain product × geography × mortgage market × series × period. Keep annual New flow and quarterly Outstanding stock separate. VALUE1 is loan-count weighted; VALUE2 is origination-amount weighted for New and quarter-end-UPB weighted for Outstanding. Enforce Appendix B VALUE1-only New series TOT_ORIG, TOT_LOANAMT, AVE_LOANAMT, AVE_PAYMENT, AVE_PROPVAL and Appendix C VALUE1-only Outstanding series TOT_LOANS, PCT_LOANS, TOT_UPB, PCT_UPB, TOT_LOANAMT, AVE_PAYMENT. Preserve raw source strings, parsed numeric nulls, suppression, units, source release and mart digest; no cross-market summing, interpolation or forecast.
method_cards.validation: PASS acquisition receipts and source hashes bound; canonical mart reconciles 3,038,100 New + 535,464 Outstanding rows, 4,980 suppressed New rows, 135,084/337,292 New VALUE1/VALUE2 missing cells, 57,888 Outstanding VALUE2 missing cells and zero invalid numeric rows. National/all-mortgage workbook reference holds 1,680 annual + 1,998 quarterly rows. Runtime checks: New 28 years, Outstanding 54 quarters, VALUE2 rejected for VALUE1-only Outstanding TOT_UPB; selected-value chart references verified in XLSX exports. Six new synthetic service tests enforce all New VALUE1-only series even when raw VALUE2 is numeric and preserve VALUE2 selection for supported AVE_INTRATE.
method_cards.limits: Aggregate sample context only; not loan-level PD/default, approval rate or Freddie vintage. Annual New flow and quarter-end Outstanding stock are separate products. Browser visual and Excel desktop acceptance remain open.

method_cards.name: HMDA descriptive denial share by decided row
method_cards.target: Describe action-3 denied rows as a share of action-1/2/3 decided LAR records within a single release, activity year, and selected filter scope.
method_cards.method: For source rows with action_taken codes 1–8, let n_k be the count of code k within the current release/year/filters. Decision denominator D=n_1+n_2+n_3; denied numerator N=n_3; descriptive denied share=N/D when D>0, otherwise unavailable. Recompute within each grouped category. Keep actions 4–8 in action counts but outside D. An action_taken breakdown has no within-action denial rate. Never pool release vintages or interpret this as repayment PD, approval rate, causal/fairness or compliance result.
method_cards.validation: Official CFPB field definitions identify action 1 as originated, 2 as approved-not-accepted, 3 as denied, 4–5 as withdrawn/incomplete, 6 as purchased, and 7–8 as preapproval outcomes. Static trace confirms the 1+2+3 contract in hmda_applications evidence, shared summarize, release-specific/national SQL views, cohort calculations, and UI. 2025 Snapshot and 2025 Dynamic as-of 2026-10-11 receipt profiles reconcile action counts 1–8 to row totals, 1+2+3 to decided counts, code 3 to denied counts, and the derived share to that ratio. Tests cover denominator, action-group nulls, zero-denominator unavailable, 2018 quarantine, filter reconciliation and cohort support.
method_cards.limits: LAR records are not a deduplicated count of unique people/applications across releases. Public rows have no stable applicant-level join key. Snapshot and dynamic vintages have different cutoff/resubmission semantics; 2025 Data Browser uses Snapshot while Dynamic updates weekly. This is an app-derived descriptive statistic, not a publisher-issued rate, PD, causal or compliance conclusion.

method_cards.name: HMDA fixed-composition denial comparison
method_cards.target: Descriptive denied / decided rate under fixed 2023 strata weights
method_cards.method: Decision denominator = actions 1+2+3. Strata = loan type × occupancy × exact public total-unit bin; cell weight = 2023 decided count / 2023 denominator. Standardized rate = sum of fixed 2023 weights × target-year cell denial rate; full rate unavailable if a positive-weight reference cell lacks target-year decisions.
method_cards.validation: 2023 reference cells and common-support cells are counted separately; rates use exact rational arithmetic and publish support coverage.
method_cards.limits: Not fully risk-adjusted, prospective, causal, fairness/compliance determination or default PD. Purchased, withdrawn, incomplete and preapproval actions stay outside the decision denominator.

method_cards.name: P4 illustrative cash-shortfall ECL research
method_cards.target: Illustrative weighted cash-shortfall amount under declared snapshot assessments
method_cards.method: 36-month bullet with principal due at month 36; monthly EIR 0.004. Assessment hazard/month 0.001 non-relief and 0.004 relief. Base/adverse weights 0.7/0.3; scenario recoveries/costs and lags differ by segment. Exact conditional hazard survival and discounted contractual-tail less net-recovery cash shortfalls are summed.
method_cards.validation: Independent source CSV + copied assumptions audit used Fraction and a separate par cash-flow identity; 1,885 checks passed in the saved audit.
method_cards.limits: Actual risk inputs, remaining contractual maturity, payment schedule, EIR and recovery are unavailable; source EL remains unavailable. Illustrative outputs are not predicted portfolio loss, accounting ECL or validated stage decisions.

method_cards.name: P4 PD/LGD/EAD scenario sensitivity
method_cards.target: Sensitivity of declared expected-loss amount to specified shocks
method_cards.method: Base segment PD/LGD/EAD: non-relief 0.01/0.25/1; relief 0.02/0.35/1. Scenarios adjust PD odds multiplier, LGD addition and EAD multiplier; EL = p′ × l′ × e′. Primary arithmetic uses exact Fraction; clipping counts and ordered attribution are retained.
method_cards.validation: Independent audit re-read raw CSV units and copied assumptions using Decimal precision 90; 2,755 checks passed in saved audit.
method_cards.limits: Parameters are declared, not fitted/calibrated; default definition is first 90+ days delinquency. EAD is reported amount times factor, not observed default-time exposure. No macro forecast is used.

method_cards.name: Toyota ABS-EE recovery reconciliation
method_cards.target: Monthly tie-out of ABS-EE recoveredAmount against deal certificate aggregate proceeds, with independent certificate component identities
method_cards.method: Keep actual collection-period start/end, filing accession and raw signs. Certificate aggregate proceeds = negative sum of the two signed liquidation/recovery rows; certificate net credit losses = gross liquidated principal + signed previously charged-off repurchased principal + both signed proceeds rows. Cross-source residual = ABS-EE recoveredAmount sum − certificate aggregate proceeds. Retain every nonzero residual without attribution or forcing to zero.
method_cards.validation: 80 periods: both certificate bridge identities pass 80/80; ABS-EE-to-certificate recovery ties 3/80; 77 remain unresolved. Residual totals +USD 2,058,647.06 in 2022-B and +USD 1,764,558.08 in 2024-B, +USD 3,823,205.14 combined. First reporting periods are 61 calendar days and are explicitly dated.
method_cards.limits: Field/timing/population/correction cause is not established. Aggregate residual is not LGD, net credit loss, PD or forecast. The two trusts share an issuer/servicer family and are not independent issuer validation.

method_cards.name: Nissan ABS-EE event, DPD and recovery exception review
method_cards.target: Reconcile deal × report-date ABS-EE aggregate metrics to Nissan deal-certificate fields; separately evaluate charge-off candidates, DPD buckets and recoveries.
method_cards.method: Preserve issuer-specific field definitions, period dates, source signs and measures. Compare positive charge-off rows, first zeroBalanceCode=4 rows and amounts across the full 23-period panel. Compare literal DPD buckets and test a one-day-earlier boundary only as a panel-wide diagnostic. Recovery delta = ABS-EE recoveredAmount minus certificate Recoveries of Defaulted Receivables. Check SEC submission history for dated amendments; never select a rule merely to fit one month.
method_cards.validation: Pool balance and positive-balance count: 23/23 exact. Positive charge-off count: 20/23; amount: 21/23; first-code-4 count: 21/23; amount: 20/23. Literal DPD: 178/184; shifted candidate: 86/184. Recovery: 17/23; six residuals total +USD 8,859.23. July 2025: 36 positive charge-off rows / +USD 655,185.56 vs certificate one defaulted receivable / signed principal −USD 59,000.49. June 2025 DPD: 2/8 literal vs 8/8 shifted in June, but shifted is worse over all periods.
method_cards.limits: Root cause, event population and cutoff remain unresolved. Public SEC submission census showed no ABS-EE/A or 10-D/A for 2025-07-31 in the checked recent rows, which does not rule out servicer-side adjustment. This is source/parser reconciliation, not model validation or event-label sign-off; do not infer LGD, fraud, net loss or a universal DPD/event rule.

method_cards.name: Contract-aware ABS source-reconciliation surveillance
method_cards.target: Identify deal-period exceptions by comparing ABS-EE reported aggregates with that contract's certificate comparator, preserving native fields and source periods.
method_cards.method: Join by contract_id × report_date, retain actual collection-period dates and source signs, and calculate recovery delta = ABS-EE recovered amount minus the contract-specific certificate comparator. A tie requires exact zero at source precision. Keep residual sums within contract only; do not pool values or rates across trusts. Retain missing values as blank. Each row links both public filings.
method_cards.validation: 103 periods across three contracts; 86 periods with any exception; 83 nonzero recovery periods. Toyota 2022-B: 2/51 ties, +USD 2,058,647.06 within deal. Toyota 2024-B: 1/29, +USD 1,764,558.08 within deal. Nissan 2024-B: 17/23, +USD 8,859.23 within deal; 178/184 literal DPD fields. Builder and API verify source/output hashes and summary controls; Excel formula checkpoints pass.
method_cards.limits: Root cause and underlying population/cutoff/field mapping remain unestablished. Not LGD, loss, fraud, ECL or model validation. The three comparators differ; no cross-deal recovery total or tie rate is valid here.

method_cards.name: Bondora three-valued 12-MOB label support and maturity diagnostic
method_cards.target: Qualify true/false/NULL support by origination year and country without fitting a model or relabeling unresolved outcomes.
method_cards.method: Verify pinned XLSX SHA and schema, retain the source label as a three-state value, group counts by issue year/country/country-year, suppress country-year cells under 50, and compare issue date plus 12 calendar months with file Last-Modified only as a diagnostic proxy. Never impute proxy-mature NULLs to false.
method_cards.validation: 789,144 rows; 86,618 true, 520,246 false, 182,280 NULL; 58 country-year cells, four suppressed. Proxy-mature group 617,724 including 10,860 NULL; these 10,860 all lack last-action evidence on/after the assumed anniversary. Aggregate workbook formulas reconcile label totals; two calendar/tri-state tests pass.
method_cards.limits: File Last-Modified is not a per-loan observation cutoff. Historical label construction and the 10,860 NULLs remain unresolved; current published default definition is not proven identical for every historical export. No PD, forecast, model fit, application feature set or commercial rights conclusion.

method_cards.name: FHFA PUDB acquisition composition and support
method_cards.target: Describe 2025 Enterprise single-family acquisition composition by the official PUDB categories and geographic/support cells.
method_cards.method: Let N=2,093,767 verified acquisition rows. For each of 16 category fields f, count n(f,c) after trimming source-code whitespace; retain blank as <BLANK>. File share=100*n(f,c)/N. For field f, b(f) is the blank-cell count across all N rows and known(f)=N-b(f); workbook nonblank-category share=100*n(f,c)/known(f), excluding the blank category. Missing%=100*b(f)/N. App shows file share; workbook also shows nonblank share and missingness. Suppress nonzero category and missingness counts below 30 with their associated shares; visible shares may sum below 100%. Analyze one dimension at a time; never sum overlapping dimensions or infer borrower-level relationships.
method_cards.validation: Schema-v4 receipt/profile: 2,093,767 rows × 66 fields; unique record_num_sf_ctf; duplicate=0; malformed=0; acquisition year=2025 and 2020 census geography. Official Enterprise counts 987,450 + 1,106,317 = 2,093,767. All 66 fields have explicit blank counts, including zeros; the workbook builder reconciles each category dimension to N and dictionary header names/order to the verified schema. See docs/N03_PUDB_FORMULA_TRACE_2026-10-17_VI.md.
method_cards.limits: Acquisition composition is not an approval/denial denominator, repayment/default label, PD, causal fairness measure or loan-level performance panel. Exact field blank counts and profile remain local-private; the public register keeps missing_cell_count null. Browser visual and native Excel open/recalculate acceptance remain pending. No imputation, forecast or model qualification.

method_cards.name: LendingClub source-population and label-readiness diagnostics
method_cards.target: Describe each source population and its field/time support independently; decide whether any outcome cohort is ready for a separately specified temporal study. No approval rate, reject inference or PD is estimated.
method_cards.method: Keep Kaggle accepted funded-loan records, Kaggle rejected application records, and Mendeley expired-loan records as separate populations and releases. Verify source hash/profile, row count, field count, date parsing, grain, status columns and dictionary mappings. Report counts and source-quality diagnostics only within each release. Record missing/invalid dates, distinguish application date, issue date and post-booking status/payment fields, and require independent evidence for decision-time feature availability and a fixed-horizon outcome. Do not union snapshots, cross-join borrowers, treat status as a horizon event, or divide rejected by accepted file counts.
method_cards.validation: Kaggle v3 source audit PASS: accepted 2,260,701 × 151 with 33 missing/invalid issue dates; rejected 27,648,741 × 9 with 0 missing/invalid application dates. Mendeley v1 profile: 1,055,054 × 90; unique ids and 838,429 Fully Paid / 216,625 Charged Off. Issuer dictionary audit checked 280 definitions/mappings. Hashes matched local source receipts. No model training was performed. Four related LendingClub tests pass 37/37 (full-source, source, temporal and dictionary modules).
method_cards.limits: Contributor and merged-source original issuer fidelity remain unverified; Kaggle uploader CC0 and Mendeley CC BY 4.0 do not by themselves resolve all upstream/third-party rights. Data vintages/populations are not interchangeable. Dictionary does not prove application-time availability. Current-status/terminal-status fields do not define a common fixed-horizon PD; rejected applications have no repayment outcome. Keep source files private and all approval/default/model claims unavailable until gates pass.
